meta.selection: per sub-type quota; rows ranked by data completeness (returns, AUM, price) then AUM; MF: Growth option, one plan per scheme
notes: Sub-types derive from catalogue categoryName / productSourceCode; SEBI AIF Cat I/II/III is not stored in the catalogue, so AIF sub-types use listed/unlisted/debt + strategy category.
Commodity: catalogue CO product holds only SGBs; Gold ETFs / Gold FoFs are MF instruments (product code MF, MF fact sheet). No silver funds in catalogue.
FD: bank vs corporate split on issuer name, because the catalogue FD product also carries NBFC deposits.
Unlisted: catalogue has a single category (Unlisted-Direct), so one sub-type.
Payloads are raw API responses (camelCase), unmodified.
